label: synthetic
workload: Context compaction: a long history is replaced by a short summary while the tool set and system prompt stay byte-identical

source.note: The shrink ratio is modelled on what agent clients actually do when they compact (a five-figure token history becomes a four-figure summary). Written by hand; no captured bytes. This is the KEYLESS variant, where no lineage may be claimed; see synthetic-compaction-keyed for the case where an explicit key makes the successor knowable.

comp.system: You are a coding agent. When the conversation grows too long it is summarized and you continue from the summary.

turns.comment: The client compacted: ~55 kB of history becomes a 4 kB summary plus the next instruction. Tools and system are untouched, which is the section 9 signature. Keyless, so the boundary is recorded and a fresh session opens WITHOUT claiming lineage.
